concepts.label: International management and organisational strategy
concepts.concept: A broad management curriculum connects international strategy and governance with accounting, finance, economics, law, marketing, organisational behaviour, leadership and quantitative and qualitative research. Its social-science methods complement Radboud’s integrated organisational curriculum; UCR does not reproduce the compulsory Global Value Chains or IBA thesis sequence. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. External thesis-entry requirements remain unresolved; this composition is provisional research.

concepts.label: Responsible enterprise and sustainable change
concepts.concept: A responsible-enterprise curriculum joins entrepreneurship and organisational leadership to climate, circular-economy assessment and sustainability governance. It studies the environmental constraints and social value of business decisions through both management and environmental-science courses; specialist IBA value-chain and thesis requirements remain distinct. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. External thesis-entry requirements remain unresolved; this composition is provisional research.

concepts.label: Business analytics and digital innovation
concepts.concept: A digital-business curriculum combines strategy, finance, markets and organisations with programming, databases, mathematical methods, data science, machine learning and AI ethics. The computational sequence provides practical data skills behind digital innovation while leaving Radboud’s independent IBA thesis and detailed organisational requirements distinct. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. External thesis-entry requirements remain unresolved; this composition is provisional research.
